question: How many sports disciplines are included in the 2nd edition of the Khelo India Para Games 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**6**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
• The **2nd edition of the Khelo India Para Games** is scheduled to take place in **2025**, as part of the Government of India's initiative to promote sports among para-athletes. 
• This edition will include a total of **6 sports disciplines**, making it more inclusive and competitive compared to its previous edition. 
• The aim of the event is to provide a platform to **para-athletes** to showcase their talent and prepare for national and international competitions, including the **Paralympic Games**. 
• The six sports disciplines included are likely to cover a range of physical and strategic capabilities, ensuring representation across a diverse set of para-sports categories. 
• The **Khelo India initiative** itself is a flagship program to promote grassroots sports in India, and this para games edition extends the vision to athletes with disabilities. 
• The initiative is spearheaded by the **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports**, Government of India, to foster inclusivity
